data.title: Saudi Arabia asks Donald Trump to give Iran negotiations a chance before striking | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: According to one regional source who spoke with the Post, during the meetings, the Saudis conveyed a request to Iran that Tehran refrain from targeting key Saudi oil and gas facilities.
